Coaches

Deng Awak founded Talata Basketball in Copenhagen in 2021 and is its head coach. He played pro in Canada, Lithuania and Denmark. Jordan Naughton played NCAA Division 1 at Wyoming and runs the Academy. These are the people who run your kid's sessions.

Book a trial How we coach

Who is in the gym

What matters is who runs the session on a wet Thursday in November. At Talata the head coaches are fixed to a team and the assistants float, so on any given night your kid is likely to be coached by more than one of the people below.

Our head coaches have all played at a level above the one they coach. They have all been the worst player in a gym at some point, and they remember what it took to stop being that.

Head coach and founder

Deng Awak

Talata Men, and on the floor with every team in the club

  • Captained Mount Royal University in Calgary, U SPORTS Canada West
  • Pro in Canada, Lithuania and Denmark: Vancouver Dragons, Raseiniai and BK Amager in the Basketligaen
  • Has coached in four countries: Canada, Lithuania, Indonesia and Denmark
  • Built and ran the basketball academy at The British School of Vilnius
  • Founded Talata in 2021, from twenty players to more than 110
Deng's full profile

Deng grew up in Alberta, Canada, and captained Mount Royal University in Calgary. He turned pro with the Vancouver Dragons, played in Lithuania for Raseiniai, then came to Copenhagen and played in the Basketligaen for BK Amager.

He has coached Kauno Žalgiris youth in Lithuania, Douglas College in Canada, the University of Copenhagen and RANS in the Indonesian league. He still plays for Talata Men and scored 34 in the overtime cup win over Hørsholm in September.

Basketligaen highlights, 2021/22BK Amager. Watch on YouTube Mount Royal highlights, 2015Calgary. Watch on YouTube
Head of Academy

Jordan Naughton

Head coach, U17, U19 and the Stevnsgade girls team

  • NCAA Division 1 at the University of Wyoming, Mountain West Conference
  • Career night at Wyoming: 20 points and 14 rebounds, 9 of 9 from the floor
  • Pro in Denmark with BK Amager in the Basketligaen
  • 6'9" forward from Rancho Cucamonga, California, Etiwanda High School
  • Coached at Canada Camp 2026 in Lethbridge, Alberta
Jordan's full profile

Jordan grew up in Rancho Cucamonga, California, and played NCAA Division 1 at the University of Wyoming, graduating in 2019. He turned pro in Denmark with BK Amager and now runs the Talata Academy: U17, U19 and the Stevnsgade girls team.

Tremaine Dalton

Founder of The Process Basketball

Tremaine leads our NBA and EuroLeague Pathway Camp, 28 to 30 December, and the Coaches Clinic on 28 and 29 December. Deng is with him on court every day.

  • Camp director for the NBA Basketball Schools in Europe
  • Technical director of the NBA Basketball School Portugal since 2024
  • Naismith Basketball Hall of Fame contributor nominee for the class of 2026
  • Trained Mathias Lessort before his 2024 EuroLeague title

How we coach

Players learn inside games, with the rules bent to force a skill. Less standing in a queue repeating a movement nobody has to make under pressure. Our sessions look louder and messier than you might expect, and the kids keep turning up.

Read how we coach

Coach somewhere else? Spend two days on our floor with Tremaine Dalton and Deng at the Coaches Clinic, 28 and 29 December.

Come and meet them

Your first session is free. Send us your kid's date of birth and we will tell you which group and which night.
